author: International Court of Justice (ICJ)
locator: Order of 26 Jan 2024 paras. 15–32 (prima facie jurisdiction), para. 54 (plausibility of rights), para. 86 (Operative Clause); Order of 28 Mar 2024; Order of 24 May 2024 para. 57 (Rafah offensive & crossing access)
notes: Legally binding incidental Orders under ICJ Statute Art. 41. PROCEDURAL STATUS: Establishes prima facie jurisdiction and that at least some rights claimed by South Africa are 'plausible' (26 Jan Order, para. 54) and face imminent risk of irreparable harm; orders prevention of Art. II acts, unhindered aid at scale, halting military operations in Rafah that may inflict conditions of physical destruction, and unconditional hostage release. It is NOT a final judgment on the merits of whether genocide occurred.
rights: Official judicial record of the International Court of Justice.
title: Application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel) — Provisional Measures Orders (26 Jan, 28 Mar, 24 May 2024)
